name: Sell Side
tagline: Price, stage and sell your home for the best price
about: Sell Side helps homeowners price realistically from comparables, stage each room before the photos, write listing copy that gets viewings, choose an agent and weigh competing offers.
persona: You are a seasoned listing agent turned coach: honest about what a home is really worth, precise about the cheap fixes that add thousands, and firm about what a buyer's offer actually means.

onboarding.title: Sell smarter, not slower
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the home and your timeline so the advice is specific.
bullets: Listing copy, agent picks, offer maths

tools.title: Price it
tools.subtitle: Comparables → asking price and range

inputs.label: Recent nearby sales / listings
inputs.placeholder: No.12: 3-bed sold 410k Apr; No.30: 3-bed listed 445k, 6 weeks…

tools.prompt: Price the profile's home using: {comps}. Condition versus those: {condition}. Produce a table (Comparable | Price | Adjustments | Adjusted value), a kv (suggested asking price, realistic sale range, price that guarantees a quick sale, price to test given the timeline), bullets on pricing psychology for this market, and a callout on the cost of overpricing and then reducing.

tools.title: Stage this room
tools.subtitle: Photo → fixes before the photographer
tools.prompt: Critique the room in the photo for sale photos and viewings, budget {budget}. Produce bullets of what a buyer notices first (good and bad), a checklist of changes ranked by impact per cost within the budget, a table (Change | Cost | Time | Impact) for anything costing money, and a callout on what to do the morning the photographer arrives.

tools.title: Write the listing
tools.subtitle: Headline, description, photo order

inputs.label: Features and quirks
inputs.placeholder: south-facing garden, new boiler 2024, near station, needs cosmetic work

tools.prompt: Write a listing for the profile's home aimed at {buyer} using: {features}. Produce a quote with a headline and a 150-word description, bullets of 8 key features in the order that buyer cares about, a kv (photo order 1–8 → what each shot shows), and a callout on claims to avoid or verify first.

tools.title: Choose an agent
tools.subtitle: Fees, tie-ins, questions to ask

inputs.label: Agents you're considering
inputs.placeholder: A: 1.2% no tie-in; B: 0.9% 16-week tie-in; C: online, fixed 999 upfront

tools.prompt: Compare these options for the profile's home and timeline: {options}. Produce a table (Agent | Fee on likely price | Tie-in | Marketing | Risk), a checklist of 10 questions to ask at the valuation visit, bullets on contract terms to strike out or negotiate, and a callout on why the highest valuation is not the best pitch.

tools.title: Weigh the offers
tools.subtitle: Price vs certainty vs speed

inputs.label: The offers
inputs.placeholder: A: 402k, first-timer, mortgage agreed; B: 395k cash, wants 4-week completion; C: 410k, in a chain of 3

tools.prompt: Rank these offers for the profile's timeline: {offers}. Produce a table (Offer | Price | Certainty 1–5 | Speed | Net after risk), text explaining the recommended pick and the trade-off, a quote with a counter message to the runner-up inviting them to improve, and a callout on questions to verify each buyer's position before accepting.

disclaimer: General information, not financial or mortgage advice; rates, rules and taxes vary by country and lender — confirm figures with a regulated adviser before acting.
